o.norm: for attributes, enforce strict unescaping (must look like &#xxx; , not just &#xxx)

i.norm:
Tests for {@link Entities#unescape} strict-mode behaviour.

Strict unescaping requires that a named entity reference is properly terminated with a semicolon (e.g. {@code &}). Without the semicolon (e.g. {@code &=}) the sequence is left untouched in strict mode but is still unescaped in non-strict (lenient) mode.
Contains both a malformed entity ("&amp=" — semicolon missing) and a well-formed entity ("&" — semicolon present).
"&amp=" is not terminated with ';', so strict mode keeps it as-is. "&" is well-formed and is unescaped to '&'.
The default (non-strict) overload unescapes "&amp=" and "&" alike.
Passing strict=false explicitly must produce the same result as the no-argument overload.
